title: Beamr’s IBC 2026 Preview: Turn Existing HD into a 4K Viewing Experience – Live or Archive
summary: Turn existing HD into a production ready 4K viewing experience in live or VOD, proven by real Viewers in days
body_markdown:
### **Some surprises awaiting you on your way to the RAI** . Beamr booth 1.D22, Hall 1


[IBC](https://beamr.com/ibc26) is almost here, and we’d love for you to come by Booth 1.D22 during the show. Bring your high-resolution pipeline challenges. That’s the conversation we’re set up for.


Your viewers compare every broadcast to the best-looking thing they saw on the same television. If your production pipeline or media archive is still in HD, the gap is real. How do you deliver a picture in the quality your viewers expect, from the footage you already have, on delivery economics that hold up?


We’re showing one answer at the booth.


#### **One pipeline, on your content, validated by real viewers in days**


Here’s the pipeline that lets you deliver up to 4Kp60 live from lower-resolution sources, with confidence:


- Lower-resolution source – live feed or media archive.
- [NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/05/3339280/0/en/beamr-brings-nvidia-video-super-resolution-to-live-sports-and-broadcast-video.html) upscales HD sources inside the production chain, where the process can be controlled and verified.
Two modes here: super resolution – add pixels from 720p or 1080p up to 4K; or quality enhancement – recover detail and improve quality at the same resolution.
- Beamr’s CABR encoding then[delivers](https://beamr.com/sr) the result in streams up to 50% smaller than standard encoding – premium picture quality without premium delivery costs.
- The entire pipeline runs end-to-end on[NVIDIA RTX PRO GPUs](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/workstations/) and can be deployed in the cloud or on-premises.
- The output is a standard AVC, HEVC, or AV1 stream.


Runs where your content already lives, cloud or on-prem, without the delivery-cost penalty upscaling normally carries.


There’s another piece to this: the upscaling or AI-enhancement adds detail the source never had. PSNR and VMAF can only tell you how close the output is to the source, and can’t tell you whether it looks better. Only viewers can.


[Beamr VISTA](https://beamr.com/vista) runs subjective quality tests at scale on your own footage, guided by our video experts, and gets you to a decision-ready answer in days rather than the weeks traditional subjective testing takes.


#### **How to get started**


>> Bring a clip. We’ll start working on it immediately.


>> Book a meeting with us at the show, to see live demos at the booth and learn more about Beamr stack[beamr.com/ibc26](https://beamr.com/ibc26)


Stay tuned as we announce more of what we’ve got planned for the show – and, yes, some surprises on your way there.


See you at IBC!
